FOUND THE CONTAMINATION CAUSE. It is self-inflicted and it is the same defect as the binding one.

Every AUTO-SPLIT child ends with the splitter's own boilerplate:

    If a detail is missing, POST /dispatch/blocked — do not invent it.

The spec writer carries that line into SPEC.md. The codegen wall then scans SPEC.md for /POST \/dispatch\/(complete|blocked)/i, finds it, and refuses to build. We write the sentence, then refuse to build because we wrote it. That is the 502 fires on alexrollin/abilifi-apps, the 62 on payload, the 46 on registry — not a model problem, not a size problem.

Added to BEB-3885 as acceptance 11 (with acceptance 10, held items must not block the loop). No new ticket — it is one deliverable.
